arrangement: A typical repository using Claude Code: project memory files at the root, team MCP config, and a .claude/ folder with settings, rules, skills, legacy commands, subagents and a hook script.

claims.text: CLAUDE.md is read at the start of every session; it holds commands, conventions and architecture notes and can import files with @path/to/import.
CLAUDE.local.md holds private per-project preferences, is appended after CLAUDE.md, and should be added to .gitignore.
A project-scoped .mcp.json is checked into version control so the team shares the same MCP servers (e.g. GitHub, databases; Jira appears as a use case).

sources.title: Connect Claude Code to tools via MCP (read 2026-11-25)

claims.text: .claude/settings.json holds permissions, hooks, env vars and model defaults; unlike CLAUDE.md these are enforced.
.claude/settings.local.json holds personal overrides and is gitignored when Claude Code saves a setting to it.
.claude/rules/*.md split instructions by topic and can be scoped to file paths with a `paths` frontmatter field.
Skills live in .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, are invoked with /skill-name, or used by Claude when it matches the task.
Custom commands (.claude/commands/*.md) have been merged into skills: single-file prompts, same mechanism.
Subagents in .claude/agents/*.md each have their own system prompt, tool access and optionally their own model.

Hooks run commands before (PreToolUse) or after (PostToolUse) tool calls; a PreToolUse hook can block the call. Hooks are defined in settings files; .claude/hooks/ is the path used in the docs' examples, not a required folder.
If a repository already has an AGENTS.md, Claude Code can read it in place of a CLAUDE.md (by default only when there is no CLAUDE.md).
Claude treats CLAUDE.md as context, not enforced configuration; settings rules are enforced by the client.
The .claude directory page lists CLAUDE.md, .mcp.json, .claude/settings.json, settings.local.json, rules/, skills/, commands/ and agents/ for a project, among other files.

components.label: rules, skills, commands, agents, hook scripts

steps.text: At session start Claude reads CLAUDE.md, then CLAUDE.local.md.
Project MCP servers from .mcp.json connect outside tools.
The client enforces settings.json: permissions, hooks, env, model.
Rules, skills, commands, agents and hook scripts extend Claude.
